quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): Group revenue HK$14,521.0 million (US$1,862.8 million), up 9.8% (continuing and discontinued operations); continuing operations revenue HK$13.74 billion (US$1.76 billion), up 10.0%, with bookings of HK$14.48 billion (US$1.86 billion), up 21.7% (SMT +40.0%, SEMI +6.3%); adjusted gross margin 38.3% (down 172 bps); adjusted net profit HK$466.7 million (+24.5%). SEMI revenue HK$7,380.5 million (+21.8%, driven by TCB) and SMT revenue HK$6,355.8 million (-1.0%). Year-end backlog HK$6.17 billion (US$792.9 million) and book-to-bill 1.05, the highest since 2021; R&D investment about HK$1.93 billion; net cash HK$3.28 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue HK$14,521.0 million (+9.8%); bookings HK$14.48 billion (+21.7%); backlog US$792.9 million

quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging and TCB in 2025 (annual report): advanced packaging revenue US$532.1 million, up 30.2% and 30% of Group revenue (26% in 2024), with record TCB revenue growth of about 146% after the breakthrough into HBM; TCB solutions for HBM4 12H were the first to secure orders from multiple players, the flux-based TCB tool was adopted for HBM4 16H sampling and the AOR fluxless process is under qualification; in logic, ASMPT is the Process-Of-Record in chip-to-substrate with continuous OSAT orders into Q1 2026, and its ultrafine-pitch C2W TCB with plasma AOR won orders for multiple tools in Q1 2026 from a leading advanced logic customer. The company estimates the TCB TAM growing from about US$760.0 million in 2025 to US$1.6 billion in 2028. Hybrid bonding: customer buy-offs and more tools shipped in 2025. Photonics revenue grew 10%, keeping dominance in 800G transceiver assembly; SMT system-in-package orders rose about 43%, driven by AI demand for base-station RF modules.
quarterly_data.figure: advanced packaging revenue US$532.1 million (+30.2%); TCB revenue growth about 146%; TCB TAM US$1.6 billion by 2028

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 revenue mix (annual report, continuing operations): Computing about 22% of revenue (largest, with the highest proportion from TCB solutions), Consumer about 17%, Communication around 16%, Automotive almost 16%, Industrial 10% (13%); China 41%, Asia outside China 34% (24%, largely TCB), Europe 13% (20%), Americas 11% (15%). Revenue from Korea rose to HK$1,155,241 thousand (HK$494,819 thousand) and Taiwan to HK$1,197,392 thousand (HK$791,443 thousand). The top five customers accounted for approximately 16% of 2025 revenue; the five largest customers and five largest suppliers were each less than 30% of sales and purchases.
quarterly_data.figure: top five customers about 16% of revenue; Korea revenue HK$1,155,241 thousand (HK$494,819 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: Q4 2025 and outlook (annual report): Q4 2025 Group revenue HK$4.33 billion (US$557.1 million), above the upper end of guidance, with continuing-operations revenue HK$3,959.0 million (+30.9% YoY) and bookings HK$3.89 billion (+28.2% YoY), the QoQ rise mainly from stronger TCB bookings. Q1 2026 revenue guided to US$470 million to US$530 million, with SEMI gross margin expected to return to the mid-40s on TCB and high-end die bonder volumes; 2026 OPEX expected to rise by about HK$200 million, mainly for advanced-packaging R&D and infrastructure; management expects AI demand to drive revenue growth across SEMI and SMT in 2026 and SMT automotive and industrial end markets to stay soft near term.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue guidance US$470 million to US$530 million

quarterly_data.signal: Portfolio transformation (annual report): ASMPT announced the voluntary liquidation of ASMPT Equipment (Shenzhen) in August 2025; on 27 November 2025 it sold its entire 49% interest in AAMI (Advanced Assembly Materials International) to Shenzhen Original Advanced Compounds (603991.SH) for cash and new shares, and now holds 29,000,000 shares (18.99%) of that lead-frame and packaging equipment and materials maker as an associate; it decided to divest ASMPT NEXX (classified as a discontinued operation); and on 21 January 2026 it began a Strategic Options Assessment of the SMT Solutions segment (divestiture, joint venture, spin-off and listing, or retention), to sharpen its focus on back-end packaging.
quarterly_data.figure: 18.99% interest in Shenzhen Original Advanced Compounds
